data.narrative:
Liminal Insights is a Series A–stage company in Climate & Energy that has raised $38.9M to date. The comparable universe spans 9 private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and 1 public reference point (LNZA), though narrow peer overlap—same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—remains insufficient to support a robust peer-median approach.

The Stage-Progression method, the sole applicable triangulation approach, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $39M raised proxy, yielding a $78M valuation. This multiplier reflects typical Series A to next-stage progression in venture capital. The peer-median method was not applied due to inadequate same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector; the broader 9-peer set lacks sufficient clustering to produce a defensible median without material selection bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $66M to $89M, with a central estimate of $78M. Key uncertainties include the absence of near-peer financial or operational metrics; the stage-progression method alone carries execution risk that later-stage investors may discount if operational milestones lag. Additional sensitivity would attach to capital efficiency and market timing within the energy transition space. A peer-median approach becomes viable upon identification of 3+ directly comparable Series A or early Series B companies with disclosed or estimated valuations.
